hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress and elevated advisory risk warrant capital preservation and a material reduction in aggregate crypto exposure. BTC retains the strongest liquidity and institutional support, but its near-zero composite makes the long signal only modestly constructive. ETH has positive composite support but carries higher beta, volatility, and expected shortfall. SOL and LTC remain weak and should receive no added risk. XRP is the most fragile signal because volatility, expected shortfall, and liquidity inputs are all zero or unavailable, making its long verdict unreliable.
